notes: Added missing stories to fully cover schema, core logic, API, and integration for Brain lock TTL and recovery.

GOV-F-003-S166.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S166.description: Define MongoDB schema and Pydantic contract for Brain lock including lock_id, owner_id, ttl_expiry, heartbeat_timestamp, and recovery_status. Ensure compatibility with existing Mongo utilities and audit logging.

GOV-F-003-S167.title: Lock TTL and Ownership Core Logic
GOV-F-003-S167.description: Implement core lock acquisition, ownership validation, TTL expiration, and heartbeat renewal logic. Enforce single-owner constraint and automatic expiration when TTL lapses.

GOV-F-003-S168.title: Lock Recovery and Crash Handling
GOV-F-003-S168.description: Implement recovery logic to detect abandoned locks via expired TTL and safely reassign ownership. Include safeguards for partial writes and ensure idempotent recovery operations.

GOV-F-003-S169.title: Brain Lock API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S169.description: Expose internal API endpoints for lock acquire, heartbeat, release, and recovery status. Integrate with existing FastAPI backend patterns and enforce authentication via brain_auth.
